notes:
Topline: trading firm building ultra-low-latency decisioning layer. Extremely cost-sensitive for high QPS (est. 400-800 req/s peak). Interested in Redwood to avoid building infra + to get predictable tail latency.

Key technical goals / quotes: 
- p95 latency target: <50ms for single-turn trading inference (strict).
- Throughput: sustained 500rps, spikes to 800rps.
- Cost target: reduce per-req inference cost by 40% vs current hosted provider.
- "We can't trade on 200ms jitter — need consistent tail." — Head of ML.

Optimize interest: batching (dynamic batching w/ latency SLO), KV/prefix caching for repeated contexts, aggressive INT8/4-bit quantization for 13B family models. Want Redwood Optimize suggestions for batch sizes + cache TTL per workload.

Model preference: open models first (Llama2-13B / Mistral variants) quantized FP4/INT8; fallback to smaller 7B low-latency variant for bursty traffic. Need automatic routing to fallback model under capacity constraints.

Security & compliance: must support VPC + HSM/KMS key management, SOC2/ISO27001 checklist, audit log export to SIEM, data residency EU/US partitioning. Legal flagged retention policy; want 30-day short-term retention and ability to purge on request.

Engagement notes: pref POC on Dedicated pool with canary routing. Will provide internal prompt set for quality regression tests (10k prompts). Ask: perf matrix for sequence lengths (16/64/256) and cost per-token at different batch sizes/quant levels.

Stated concerns: model quality regression after quantization; want automatic quality-monitoring and rollback. Budget: up to $120k ARR if POC meets latency + cost targets.

Sales snippets: prioritize SE time to design batching/caching config, propose benchmarking template (p95, p99, throughput, cost-per-req, token-cost curves).
